## 4. Key Project Case Studies

### Project 1: DIGIPANCH — AI-Powered Rural Administration Platform
- **URL**: https://www.digipanch.live
- **Category**: Civic Tech / AI Governance / Enterprise Web Application
- **Stack**: Next.js, FastAPI (Python), PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
- **Problem Solved**: Traditional rural governance workflows in India were paper-heavy, manual, fragmented, and difficult for rural citizens to access transparently.
- **Solution**: Built an end-to-end digital platform providing multi-role citizen services, AI-assisted administrative document workflows, and real-time governance metrics.
- **Impact**: Demonstrated scalable civic technology architecture capable of modernizing local government administration.

### Project 2: POYODHARA — Premium Product Showcase Storefront
- **URL**: https://poyodhara.vercel.app/
- **Category**: Product Showcase / Brand Storefront
- **Stack**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, GSAP
- **Problem Solved**: Regional bottled water brands lacked high-quality digital brand presence and modern interactive storefronts.
- **Solution**: Designed and engineered a visual-first product showcase highlighting brand purity, eco-packaging, and distributor contact workflows.
- **Impact**: Boosted brand credibility and elevated customer engagement.

### Project 3: BEYOND PINKS — High-Conversion Fashion E-Commerce Platform
- **URL**: https://byondpinks.vercel.app/
- **Category**: E-Commerce / Fashion Retail
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS
- **Problem Solved**: Independent fashion labels require dynamic product display, quick page load times, and fluid mobile UX to drive sales.
- **Solution**: Created a lightweight, conversion-focused online shopping storefront with smooth product galleries and seamless UI navigation.
- **Impact**: Elevated visual brand identity and improved customer browsing speed.
